t02: third-party header units (fmt/format.h, nlohmann/json.hpp, boost/optional.hpp on Linux) imported together with STL header units in one TU (all.cpp); a TU that imports fmt but not <string> although fmt includes <string> (fmt_only.cpp); a TU importing both <string> and fmt, i.e. two header units with overlapping content that must merge (both.cpp). Per-source selection: each TU gets only the sets it uses. GCC only: the driver also checks that the CMIs do not depend on build order (isolated header-unit builds).
